item.title: Opportunity Knocks: 543 Franklin Street Includes “Rare Stone Sauna House”
item.description: Seeing 543 Franklin Street being listed for sale brought up a lot of memories for me. This was once the home, and place of business, for Sandy Hertel, who ran a fabric shop out of the circa 1852 residence. Before her passing in 2017, Sandy was an devout preservationist, and community activist. She made her mark from the mid-lower West Side to Elmwood Avenue to Allentown.
